hero_titlu: Stories about destiny, love, and the courage to start over.
hero_citat: Make your life a dream, and your dream a reality.
carte1_rezumat: David's life takes a dark turn, marked by betrayal and loss. When he meets the beautiful Elena, it seems he has finally found the light he needed — until she disappears without a trace.
carte2_rezumat: Patrick Adams receives news that changes his life forever, and sets off on a journey through Rome, Paris, and London to keep a promise he waited far too long to make.
despre_text1: Dan Morea writes about destiny, love, and the moments that change a person forever. His stories follow characters facing loss and regret, and the need to move forward — above all, the courage to begin again.
despre_text2: Every novel starts from the same conviction: that life deserves to be lived as a dream we choose, not a wait we endure.
